name: Alpengasthof Schneeberg
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Schneeberg is a traditional inn in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterland. It is situated in a quiet location on the edge of the village with views of the surrounding mountains and Lake Thiersee. The accommodation offers rooms with modern comforts as well as a guest parlour with regional Tyrolean cuisine. A special feature is the use of products from its own farm and from local producers. The inn serves as a starting point for hikes in summer and ski tours in winter. The establishment combines traditional ambience with practical amenities. Guests can expect personal service and a quiet, close-to-nature environment.
